newsitem.title: USA: E Pennsboro Schools, Pa., adjusted TIC, details.
newsitem.headline: E Pennsboro Schools, Pa., adjusted TIC, details.

text.p: Public Financial Management, Inc, financial advisor to the East Pennsboro Area School District, Pa., said it recalculated William R. Hough & Co's winning bid for the District's $9.290 million bond issue. William R. Hough's winning true interest cost is 4.8964 percent, reflecting the cost of bond insurance, not the 4.85 percent originally calculated.
The final details follow. Please note that the coupon rates in 1999 for both Series A and AA are 4.10 percent, not 4.20 as previously reported.
